name: effect-restart
purpose: Exercise process-independent operation identity, durable workspace reconciliation, fail-closed external recovery, and workspace metadata containment after an interrupted side effect.

input.prompt: Resume the same file-read intent in a new agent process; retain its semantic operation identity while keeping repeated reads in one run independently addressable.
Resume a VS Code edit after the file reached the requested content but the process stopped before recording its receipt; do not write the file twice.
input.interruption: process exited after atomic rename and before terminal receipt

input.prompt: Resume a CLI file creation after its content is already durable but its receipt is missing; prove the postcondition and skip a second apply.
input.interruption: CLI stopped after file commit and before receipt settlement

input.prompt: Resume an interrupted remote publish when only a process-local reconciler is available; do not ask it or the publish host to guess the remote state.
Open a workspace whose .devseek metadata path is a symbolic link to an external directory; do not write operation evidence outside the workspace.
